note: Trainable: eligible for the fine-tune query distribution. Work spans two texts (doctrine + ritual).

queries.query: what Levi identifies as the single hidden medium behind magnetism, visions, and every magical operation — the Astral Light the old chemists concealed under other names
queries.note: The Magic Chain chapter; 'Great Magical Agent', 'soul of the earth', 'Azoth and Magnesia', 'key of all empire' paraphrased; Astral Light kept — the work's signature concept.

queries.query: Levi's three emblems of the true initiate — a lamp, a mantle, and a staff tied to Trismegistus, Apollonius, and the patriarchs — standing for illumined reason, self-possession, and steadiness
queries.note: The Initiation chapter; the glosses 'reason illuminated by science', 'full and complete self-possession' reworded; the emblem names kept as proper-noun anchors.

queries.query: why Levi reads the horned idol of the sorcerers' sabbath not as a real devil but as a misunderstood symbol, magic dividing into a path of the sanctuary and a path of the wilderness
queries.note: The Sabbath of the Sorcerers chapter; 'immolated and emissary goat', 'White and Black Church', 'monster throned upon an altar' paraphrased away.

queries.query: the daily austerities Levi prescribes for tempering a would-be magician's will: rising at a fixed early hour, washing at a spring before daybreak, and freely chosen denials to harden oneself against those that come unbidden
queries.note: The Preparations chapter; 'voluntary privations, that you may be better able to bear those which come without seeking' recast; 'never wear soiled clothes' dropped.

queries.query: what is the philosopher's stone really — a literal substance or a symbol of inner perfection
queries.note: The introduction's claim that the Stone and Universal Medicine are terms to be understood in their proper sense; inner-alchemy readings recur across traditions. No target — graded post-hoc.

queries.query: does evil come from a second hostile power or from imbalance within a single force
queries.note: The impure duad and the misconstrued doctrine of Zoroaster; the dualism question is pan-traditional. No target — graded post-hoc.
